title: Never married; devotion to New Orleans music
summary: Russell never married, being too busy collecting, and says he has always loved New Orleans music.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Never had time. You're too busy running around collecting. No wife would ever put up the way I move around from one place to another and spend my time on music records or anything that came into my head that way I'd get.
Do you have any personal points of view that might, might have one that was interested in you that you'd like to express before we go into these musicians?
No, I can't really think of anything.
Don't you think you've really spent your life trying to sell New Orleans music?
I don't mean sell it. I mean to interest people in it, because it really means a great deal to you.
Yes, I've always loved the music so much, and naturally I've always talked about the musicians as being the greatest music I've heard.
